queriesRunVerbatim.sql: SELECT facet, rail_state, count(*)::int AS n FROM county_facet_coverage GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT county_fips, rail_state, honest_coverage_pct, threshold_pct, source, verified_by_instrument, artifact_path, last_verified_at FROM county_facet_coverage WHERE facet = 'zoning' AND rail_state = 'satisfied-present' ORDER BY county_fips LIMIT 50;

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE rail_state = 'satisfied-present')::int AS naive_satisfied_present, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rail_state = 'satisfied-present' AND honest_coverage_pct::numeric >= COALESCE(threshold_pct::numeric, 95))::int AS depth_gate_keeps, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rail_state = 'satisfied-present' AND (honest_coverage_pct IS NULL OR honest_coverage_pct::numeric < COALESCE(threshold_pct::numeric, 95)))::int AS depth_gate_demotes_to_not_yet FROM county_facet_coverage WHERE facet = 'zoning';

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE display_state = 'satisfied-present')::int AS naive_satisfied, count(*)::int AS total FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN r.atom_family_state <> 'present' THEN 'no-atom' WHEN r.has_writer = false THEN 'no-writer' WHEN c.rail_state IS NULL THEN 'not-yet' ELSE c.rail_state END AS display_state FROM county_manifest m CROSS JOIN county_rail r LEFT JOIN county_facet_coverage c ON c.county_fips = m.county_fips AND c.facet = r.rail_key) x;

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE kept)::int AS api_like_satisfied FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN r.atom_family_state <> 'present' THEN false WHEN r.has_writer = false THEN false WHEN c.rail_state IS NULL THEN false WHEN c.rail_state = 'satisfied-absent' THEN true WHEN c.rail_state = 'satisfied-present' AND r.rail_key IN ('cad','zoning','envelope','landuse','easement','owner') AND (c.honest_coverage_pct IS NULL OR c.honest_coverage_pct::numeric < COALESCE(c.threshold_pct::numeric, r.threshold_pct)) THEN false WHEN c.rail_state IN ('satisfied-present','satisfied-absent') THEN true ELSE false END AS kept FROM county_manifest m CROSS JOIN county_rail r LEFT JOIN county_facet_coverage c ON c.county_fips = m.county_fips AND c.facet = r.rail_key) x;

SELECT c.county_fips, m.county_name, c.honest_coverage_pct::numeric AS pct, c.threshold_pct::numeric AS thr, c.source, (c.honest_coverage_pct::numeric < COALESCE(c.threshold_pct::numeric, 95)) AS demoted_by_depth_gate FROM county_facet_coverage c JOIN county_manifest m ON m.county_fips = c.county_fips WHERE c.facet = 'zoning' AND c.rail_state = 'satisfied-present' ORDER BY demoted_by_depth_gate DESC, c.county_fips LIMIT 30;
SELECT rail_key, atom_family_state, has_writer, threshold_pct FROM county_rail ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 20;

SELECT i.indexrelname, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid)) AS idx_size, pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid) AS idx_bytes, i.idx_scan, i.idx_tup_read, i.idx_tup_fetch, pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) AS indexdef FROM pg_stat_user_indexes i WHERE i.relname = 'atoms' ORDER BY pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid) DESC;

SELECT c.relname, c.reltuples::bigint AS reltuples_est, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS heap_size, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) AS total_size, pg_relation_size(c.oid) AS heap_bytes, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS total_bytes FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'atoms';

SELECT ic.relname AS index_name, i.indisunique, i.indisprimary, i.indpred IS NOT NULL AS is_partial, pg_get_expr(i.indpred, i.indrelid) AS pred FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_class tc ON tc.oid = i.indrelid WHERE tc.relname = 'atoms' ORDER BY ic.relname;

SELECT tablename, attname, null_frac, n_distinct, correlation FROM pg_stats WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'atoms' AND attname IN ('section_number','jurisdiction_tenant','entity_type','entity_id') ORDER BY attname;
EXPLAIN (FORMAT TEXT) SELECT atom_did FROM atoms WHERE entity_type = 'code-section' LIMIT 1;
SELECT count(*)::bigint AS code_section_n FROM (SELECT 1 FROM atoms WHERE entity_type = 'code-section' LIMIT 100000) s;
SELECT count(*)::bigint AS section_number_nonnull_capped FROM (SELECT 1 FROM atoms WHERE section_number IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100000) s;
EXPLAIN (FORMAT TEXT) SELECT atom_did FROM atoms WHERE entity_type = 'parcel-node' AND body->>'parcelNodeId' = '48021:34137' LIMIT 5;
